record.question: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) number of India, for accessing emergency services like Police, Fire and Medical is:
record.explanation: Answer D: 112. India’s Emergency Response Support System uses 112 as the unified emergency number. Reference: https://www.mha.gov.in/nirbhayaerss-section. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
